stages.name: Starter Barn
stages.prompt: Create ONE isolated complete barn sprite for Meadow Markets, one stage of a coordinated four-stage upgrade family. FIRST reference is this stage's EXACT foundation shape and orthographic camera guide. SECOND reference is the FINAL GRAND BARN for art direction only: match the exact red plank colours, ivory timber, slate-blue roof, golden hay, warm polished hand-painted storybook farming-game finish, black iron hardware and stone foundation. This requested stage MUST be noticeably simpler than that final barn; do not copy its premium additions. Keep the broad braced-door facade facing lower-left and side wall facing lower-right. Ground-plane edges parallel at +28.2 and -28.2 degrees, vertical beams vertical, no vanishing point. One clean rectangular thin stone foundation fits the guide exactly; all structures inside it. Transparent background with clean alpha, no grass island, no surrounding ground, no text or grid, no people or animals. Complete unclipped sprite with transparent clearance on all sides. STAGE 1 STARTER BARN, 2x2 tile footprint, equal visible base edge lengths. A SMALL humble single-storey red wooden livestock barn for two animals. Simple straight gabled roof (NOT gambrel), plain ivory trim, ONE pair of braced red doors and ONE small side window. Low roof, compact square ground plan. No hayloft, no upper window, no cupola, no silo, no stable bays, no lanterns, no flower boxes. Well cared for but basic, charming little starter building. Its fewer features and small proportions must make it the unmistakable beginning of the upgrade line.

stages.name: Grand Livestock Barn
stages.prompt: Create ONE new production-ready GRAND LIVESTOCK BARN stage 4 of a coordinated four-stage upgrade set for Meadow Markets. Transparent background. The FIRST reference is the STRICT 4x3 ground grid and camera guide. The SECOND reference is the correct upright red barn camera and materials. The THIRD reference is the luxurious older grand barn's FEATURES and charm, NOT its incorrect shallow camera. New final stage must be visibly more advanced than a hayloft barn: retain large ivory-braced double doors and open golden-hay loft, add a handsome roof cupola with weather vane, a clearly visible small attached red grain silo tucked within the rear-left part of the rectangle, and TWO open livestock stable bays integrated into the RIGHT side of the main rectangular footprint under a connected slate roof. Add refined timber framing, black iron door hardware, two small flower boxes attached to walls, tidy hay in the bays. Warm detailed polished storybook mobile farm game art, red plank walls, ivory wood beams, dark slate-blue gambrel roof, sunlit hand-painted materials. Footprint must be ONE clean rectangular thin sandstone foundation matching the first guide, front-left wall spans FOUR units, right wall spans THREE units. Silo and all bays stand INSIDE that rectangle, no side annex extending outside, no foreground trough, no grass island. All ground-plane beams and base edges follow the SAME +28.2/-28.2 degree parallel axes. Vertical walls vertical, orthographic higher camera, no near-horizontal ground edges, no vanishing point. Face broad double-door front toward lower-left and stable-bay side toward lower-right. Keep compact proportions, avoid towering roof. Entire complete asset safely within canvas, isolated on genuine transparent alpha. No text, badges, grid, UI, animals, people, scenery or background. This is the richest final stage; it must clearly retain and improve on the old grand barn's cupola/silo/stable features while fixing its geometry.
